description: Formal HR Screening Question Category Mapping, Evaluation Weights, and Intent Taxonomy.

Introduction.description: Assesses candidate self-presentation, verbal clarity, communication style, and role interest.
evaluation_criteria: Clarity and confidence in verbal delivery
Alignment with company and role culture

Education.description: Verifies academic credentials, graduation status, major discipline, and relevant computer science coursework.
evaluation_criteria: Fulfillment of role educational qualification prerequisites
Relevance of specialization to required engineering discipline

Experience.description: Verifies duration of relevant industry work, current employer context, and hands-on system architecture contributions.
evaluation_criteria: Consistency between stated experience and resume dates
Depth of technical involvement in recent engineering initiatives
Familiarity with production environments and development lifecycle

Skills.description: Assesses candidate hands-on depth in role-specific frameworks, databases, libraries, and engineering best practices.
evaluation_criteria: Accurate self-assessment and practical knowledge of core stack
Ability to discuss technical challenges and optimizations

Location.description: Validates current residence, work model preference (on-site, hybrid, remote), and relocation availability.
evaluation_criteria: Compatibility with hiring team location / office policy

Salary.description: Captures current CTC breakdown (Fixed + Variable) and candidate expected CTC in LPA for budget alignment.
evaluation_criteria: Alignment of expected CTC with designated role salary band
Reasonableness of salary hike expectation relative to industry standards

Notice period.description: Confirms official notice duration with current company, buyout possibilities, and earliest joining date.
evaluation_criteria: Notice period within hiring urgency constraints (<= 30 or 60 days)
Clarity on last working day if currently serving notice
